decided: A sensor fires when a change adds requirement changes for a capability its proposal does not list, comparing against the proposal as it stood when building began. A listed capability with no requirement changes is noted, not fired on.
alternatives: compare against the proposal as it stands at each check
why: The proposal may be revised during its review but not once building starts; across the 40 latest finished changes the list matched every time, so the sensor would have fired on none.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
The moment a change's building begins, after which its plan no longer changes; a sensor compares against the plan and settings as they stood then.
